name: Silent Film
summary: An engraved ink-and-silver-wash drawing projected as a flickering, weaving, scratched print inside a picture house, with intertitle cards instead of voices, deco borders that follow the emotion, an iris, velvet drapes and footlights, and at most one hand-tinted colour.

palette.use: the intertitle card; the dark screen before the lamp strikes
sepia mid: the tone ramp at L = 0.6
sepia high: highlights in the print
the one colour: hand-tinted blue light, kept through the print (proposed for this topic; the source's example is #d97757)
the drapes, lit by the screen's spill and by footlights (proposed)
brown edge fog on the print

type.case: small caps for titles and shouts; sentence-case italic for narration
type.emphasis: the card's border follows the emotion: a heavy rule for a shout, a double rule for narration, vines for tenderness

banned: noir: hard shadows as mood, voice-over
a sepia filter over modern animation: the drawing itself is engraved and inked
a pastiche of any star comedian: never the famous bowler, toothbrush moustache and cane
any real film's gags or a published melody
foley and voice: the piano is the sound design
dissolves within a scene; whip pans; big close-ups of rigged faces; implied motion blur
